name: set_chart_type
description: Change how the chart is drawn. Use for 'show this as bars', 'make it a line chart', 'pie chart please', 'switch to a radar plot'.

type.description: The chart style to render. Pie and doughnut collapse each product line to its total.

name: set_title
description: Set the chart's title text. Use for 'call it Q4 revenue', 'title this Revenue by product line', 'change the heading to something shorter'.

text.description: The new title. Long titles are truncated.

name: set_axis_scale
description: Switch an axis between a linear and a logarithmic scale. Use for 'use a log scale', 'the small numbers are invisible', 'put the vertical axis on a log scale', 'back to linear'.

axis.description: Which axis to change. On bar, line and radar charts only y carries values.

name: set_axis_range
description: Pin an axis to a fixed minimum and maximum. Use for 'start the y axis at zero', 'cap the vertical axis at 100000', 'zoom in between 0 and 50k'.

min.description: Lowest value to show. Omit to let the chart choose.

max.description: Highest value to show. Omit to let the chart choose.

name: set_series_colour
description: Recolour one product line. Use for 'make enterprise green', 'colour teams purple', 'self-serve should be red'.

series.description: The product line to recolour. Matched loosely against the series names.

name: toggle_series
description: Show or hide one product line. Use for 'hide enterprise', 'just show me teams', 'bring self-serve back'.

series.description: The product line to show or hide. Matched loosely against the series names.

visible.description: True to show the series, false to hide it.

name: set_legend_position
description: Move the legend, or take it off the chart entirely. Use for 'put the legend on the right', 'drop the legend, it's in the way', 'legend at the bottom'.

position.description: Where to put the legend, or hidden to remove it.

name: set_stacked
description: Stack the product lines on top of each other instead of drawing them side by side. Use for 'stack them', 'show me the combined total', 'unstack these'.

enabled.description: True to stack the series, false to draw them side by side.

name: sort_data
description: Reorder the months by total value instead of by calendar order. Use for 'biggest first', 'sort ascending', 'put them back in date order'.

order.description: Ascending, descending, or back to calendar order.

name: filter_months
description: Limit the chart to a range of months, numbered 1 for January through 12 for December. Use for 'just the last quarter', 'show me the first half', 'only March to June'.

from.description: First month to show, 1 for January through 12 for December.

to.description: Last month to show, 1 for January through 12 for December.

name: toggle_gridlines
description: Show or hide the gridlines on one axis. Use for 'hide the gridlines', 'turn the horizontal lines back on', 'lose the grid'.

visible.description: True to show the gridlines, false to hide them.

name: reset_chart
description: Put every setting back to its default and show all twelve months again. Use for 'start over', 'reset', 'undo everything', 'back to normal'.
